title: NatureSettings
description: Data file content/nature/settings.json (B5 R13, R11, R51; A1380 N1, plan D989): the nature takt. Growth runs as integer sums per growth group - factor (permille, by season and drought) times ticks - so a place that was used up grows back once the sum since then reaches regrow_hours x 1000 (spawns.json). A group with 1000 everywhere grows exactly as by the clock. The takt also keeps sums of wet, frost and frost-on-wet takts for the durability of things (R51, K3).

takt_minutes.description: Game minutes of one nature takt; season and weather are read at its start and hold for the whole takt.

types.description: Which object types belong to which growth group; a regrowing type without a group grows by the clock.

influences.description: The influence sums for durability (R51); omitted = none kept.

seasons.description: Growth in permille per season of the calendar (1000 = as by the clock, 0 = nothing grows); a season not listed counts 1000.

drought_permille.description: Growth during a drought, in permille of the season's growth; omitted = 1000 (the drought does not matter).

heat_min_tenth_c.description: A takt counts as hot from this air temperature on.

wet_frost_takts.description: A frost takt counts as frost on wet things when the last wet takt is at most this many takts back.
